dimension_scores.observation: Fixed CI failure in one iteration. Identified environment-dependent test (AI assumed pre-existing dev database). Fixed with specific prompt requiring setup/teardown. dimension_scores.evidence: Fix: 'Integration test fixed - now creates users/teams/invitations in setup phase, no assumptions about pre-existing state. CI green after fix.'

dimension_scores.observation: Chose Production-Grade over Ship and Iterate. Reasoning: trust costly to rebuild, won't get shut down day three. Five critical tests identified most fragile system points (privilege escalation, IDOR, concurrent invitations, WebSocket reconnection, audit integrity). Recognized AI-generated tests environment-dependent - human review essential for assumptions.
dimension_scores.evidence: Decision: 'Production-Grade - full test suite, complete documentation, CI pipeline, rollback plan. Tradeoff: takes longer but won't get shut down day three. Five critical tests reveal what's most fragile. Ship and Iterate like restaurant without fire suppression - risky.'

public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates production-quality AI-augmented engineering. Complete feature built entirely through AI agents, human-reviewed, made production-ready with comprehensive testing, documentation, CI, and rollback planning. Proves AI can be used to ship production features when paired with rigorous human review and production-grade practices.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Reflection: 'Demo-ready works on your machine. Production-ready works in any environment. Requires regression tests, documentation for new engineers, CI that catches breakage automatically, deployment strategy with rollback plan. This is difference between I built it with AI and I shipped it with AI.'

Reflection: 'Five critical tests reveal system fragility: privilege escalation, IDOR, concurrent invitation acceptance, WebSocket reconnection with event replay, audit log integrity under failure. Not just happy paths - these are things that if broke silently would cause most damage.'

Reflection: 'AI-generated tests depend on generation context - assume pre-existing dev database state. CI failure: test passes locally, fails in CI. AI has no concept of environments - writes code that works in environment it can see. Human review essential for environment assumptions.'
